Omar Khan: Hey all, quick heads-up: starting Monday onsite but my SSN card is delayed in mail. HR portal says I-9 requires original. Any options for Day-1 badge/access?
Lena Park: Hi Omar 955 (typo)  Facilities can do temporary escort/badge for up to 8 hours if we have a government photo ID and a signed attestation. Can you bring passport?
Omar Khan: I have passport and a scanned SSN application receipt. I can be at lobby 9:30am.
Theo Garcia: Security note: passport + SSN application receipt qualifies for a provisional I-9, but HR must log an "I-9 waiting for SSN" exception. @HR Bot please create.
HR Bot: Created case I9-2026-321. Exception logged: "SSN pending via SSA receipt". Assigned to Lena Park.
Lena Park: Thanks. Facilities can issue a temporary badge (expires EOD Monday) after Security signs off. Escort: Dana.
Riley Brooks: Security here. We'll verify passport, collect the SSN application receipt copy, and require you to follow up with the original SSN card within 30 days. Please ACK.
Omar Khan: ACK. I'll bring originals asap.
Theo Garcia: One more: background check returned a name variation flag (Omar vs Omar A. Khan). HR needs a short form explaining the variation; a simple signed note typically clears it. Can you upload that to the portal?
Omar Khan: Yep. Uploading a signed name-variation note and my marriage certificate (name change paperwork) now.
HR Bot: Background team notified. Prioritizing for Day-1 clearance. Typical turnaround 24-48 hours.
IT Bot: Omar 54, do you need a loaner laptop on Day-1 or will you bring BYOD?
Omar Khan: Prefer a loaner to avoid delays.
IT Bot: Noted. IT ticket IT-2026-998 created. Loaner available for pick-up in Dev Bay B between 12-3pm. Handoff code: RED-LOAN-301.
Lena Park: Facilities will coordinate handoff. Please bring ID to pick up.
Payroll: Payroll here 5. If W-4/DIRECT DEPOSIT not completed by EOD Monday, your first payroll might be delayed by one cycle. Recommend completing E-forms Day-1 remote or in lobby on arrival (we can provide a kiosk).
Omar Khan: Will do W-4 + direct deposit right after orientation. Is there a way to confirm payroll receipt?
Payroll: Yes, email confirmation sent once forms processed. If you don't receive it within 48 hours, ping payroll.
Theo Garcia: For benefits: enrollment window opens Day 1 but coverage effective first of next month; benefits orientation can be scheduled Day 2 with Benefits Ops.
Omar Khan: Sounds good. Thanks for the help everyone. See you Monday 9:30am at the main lobby.
Lena Park: Welcome aboard! We'll keep the badge and loaner ready pending HR clearance.
HR Bot: Reminder: add "follow up SSN original within 30 days" to employee record.
Riley Brooks: Security will log the temporary badge pickup. Bring the handoff code RED-LOAN-301 for IT.
Omar Khan: Got it 5. Appreciate the fast coordination :thumbsup:
